b: Ok so I know this sounds super silly but recently my boyfriend and I reached 2 years. He and I are planning his move in, and our future together. However, I am getting just… idk about quirks of his. His breathing for example. He will breathe in, hold his breath and exhale loudly. It’s irritating. Other days after work(I am a daycare teacher), I come home exhausted and ask for some quiet. He instead rambles for 30 mins before I shut down.

He will always ask me what’s for dinner, what are we doing today, yada yada. Never takes the initiative. I would love to have one day where I sit, do fuck all and he does it all. I mean it. He is bad for copying words I say or phrases I say in this high pitched voice to imitate me and it was funny at first but it’s just getting to a point.
Today alone he’s complained 5 different times that I got him sick, because I’m a daycare teacher! “This is your fault” “I blame you for my sick.”
How do I get over these random icks? I’ve tried hard to get over them but I can’t I just can’t.
